proof_summary: The adjacent-summand ratio shows that the binomial weights concentrate around \(k=((5-\sqrt5)/10)n\), with geometrically negligible tails; on this central window the exact multiplier from \(n\) to \(n+1\), \((n+1-k)/(n+1-2k)\), converges uniformly to the golden ratio, so its \(L\)-th power controls the ratio of the sums. Binet’s formulas identify \(\varphi^L\) with the stated Fibonacci–Lucas expression, while \(L=0\) is handled directly.
